arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'booking', booking_id, json_object('request_id', request_id, 'flight_id', flight_id, 'passenger_id', passenger_id, 'amount_cents', amount_cents, 'status',status,'client_reference', client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status != 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'idempotency_key',idempotency_key,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'state',state,'created_step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status != 'confirmed') UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status = 'pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights

SELECT 'flight' AS kind,flight_id AS id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) AS data FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',booking_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status = 'pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config

SELECT 'cancel' AS kind,event_id AS id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) AS data FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',booking_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at) FROM bookings WHERE client_reference IS NOT NULL OR status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'idempotency_key',idempotency_key,'state',state,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'created_step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending') UNION ALL SELECT 'hold',booking_id,json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id) FROM holds WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending') UNION ALL SELECT 'refund',refund_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'charge_id',charge_id) FROM refunds
